title: feat(console): an action's param dialog names its own submit verb (`submitText` drawn in place of Confirm)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoHqHVEAxMpoiSQcTy1f7dFE)_

Fixes #28158
Refs #27944

Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/types` `UIActionSchema` and `@object-ui/core` `ActionDef` gain the optional member `submitText`, typed by derivation from the spec's `ActionSchema`; `@object-ui/i18n` `useObjectLabel()` gains the resolver `actionSubmitText`; no key, route or error code is added)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：动作的参数对话框（例如 HotCRM 的「发送邮件」「记录通话」「记录会议」）的提交按钮，现在显示动作自己声明的 `submitText`（如「发送」「记录通话」），没声明时仍是「确认」，上传文件时仍是「上传中…」。翻译包里的 `_actions.ACTION.submitText` 优先，其次是作者写的多语言文本（按当前语言取），最后是作者写的字符串。Studio 的动作表单也能填这个键了，`os i18n extract` 会为带参数的动作生成它的翻译位。
- 为什么改：`submitText` 已在 #28188 写进 spec，但控制台一直画「确认」，作者写的按钮文字没人显示。
- 风险与回滚：只改按钮文字，提交逻辑不变；没写 `submitText` 的动作完全不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx` 与 `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `paramCollectionHandler`（新增的 `submitText` 解析）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx` 提交按钮那一行；`packages/spec/liveness/action.json` 的 `submitText` 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.submitText-28158.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/hooks/__tests__/useConsoleActionRuntime.submitText-28158.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.paramSubmitText-28158.test.tsx packages/i18n/src/__tests__/useObjectLabel-actionSubmitText-28158.test.tsx`，预期 4 个文件、20 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The dialog** (`ActionParamDialog.tsx`). `ParamDialogState` gains `submitText?: string`, the already-resolved label. The submit button draws it, falls back to `actionDialog.confirm` when it is absent or empty, and still says `actionDialog.uploading` while a file param uploads.

**Both param-collection handlers** (`useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx#paramCollectionHandler`, `RecordDetailView.tsx#paramCollectionHandler`) resolve it the way they resolve `description`: `actionSubmitText(keyObject, action.name, pickLocalized(action.submitText, language))`. So the bundle's `objects.OBJECT._actions.ACTION.submitText` (`globalActions.ACTION.submitText` for an object-less action) comes first, then the authored inline locale map collapsed to the active language, then the authored string.

**The resolver** (`@object-ui/i18n` `useObjectLabel().actionSubmitText`), the sibling of `actionDescription`, on the same `actionSuffixes` node rule (a bound action never reads `globalActions`). Its member-count pin in `useObjectLabel-identity-5564.test.tsx` goes from 28 to 29.

**Types.** `UIActionSchema.submitText?: SpecAction['submitText']` and `ActionDef.submitText?: SpecActionInput['submitText']`, both derived. `ACTION_DEF_KEYS` lists it, and the `SPEC_ACTION_KEYS` comment no longer calls it inventory-only.

**The four action renderers** (`action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group`, `action:menu`) forward `submitText` to the runner. `check:action-forward-parity` (ui) reds without this once the handlers read the key: the key would be dropped one hop before the dialog. `action-forward-precedence.test.tsx` lists it beside `description`.

**Spec rows.** `liveness/action.json` `submitText` flips `planned` → `live` with these read points, and drops `authorWarn` / `authorHint` in the same edit; `state-counts/action.md` regenerates. The `action` / `submitText` omit row leaves `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`, and `action.form.ts` gains a plain `submitText` row ("Submit button label"), not gated on `params`, because the parse refuses the key beside an empty `params` by name. The `platform-objects` metadata-forms bundles regenerate (`node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`); the zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES values are hand-translated. The prose clause "(declared ahead of its console reader: no renderer shows it yet)" leaves `ActionSchema.submitText`'s `.describe()`, and "no renderer shows it yet" leaves the translation slot's; `content/docs/references/**` regenerates (`check:generated --fix`). The seat ruled that trim into this PR. Nothing else in the schema changes.

**`os i18n extract`** (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`, `pushActionSubmitText`). It scaffolds `submitText` under an action's translation root only for an action with a non-empty `params`, the population `translateAction` overlays it onto. It is optional-not-derived like `description`, and there is no slot for a paramless action.

**Changeset** `.changeset/28158-action-param-dialog-submit-text.md`, all `patch` (`Metadata-protocol: none`).

## Tests

- `ActionParamDialog.submitText-28158.test.tsx` (5): the verb is drawn, the fallback is Confirm (also for `''`), the verb button submits, and Uploading wins while a file uploads.
- `useConsoleActionRuntime.submitText-28158.test.tsx` (5) and `RecordDetailView.paramSubmitText-28158.test.tsx` (5), one per reader: the authored string, the bundle winning, an inline map collapsed to the active language before it is offered as the fallback, the key object asked (global for an object-less action, the page object when the action declares none), and nothing handed over when nothing resolves.
- `useObjectLabel-actionSubmitText-28158.test.tsx` (5): the object node, the global node, no global read for a bound action (with a control), the miss answers.
- `RecordDetailView.paramRuntimeParity-6431.test.tsx`: `submitText` joins `DIALOG_READS`, and the two runtimes write the same value.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-extract-action-submit-text.test.ts` (7): top-level, global and inline actions; the seed-less slot; no slot without params; bundle seed and coverage gating; one fixture through `ActionSchema` → extract → `ObjectTranslationDataSchema`.
- Sibling pins that mock `useObjectLabel` partially gain an `actionSubmitText` passthrough (`overrideNotice`, `paramDialogTitle`, `paramRefusal-13161`, `oneToastPerRefusal-13340`, `flowRowGuard-13397`).

## Acceptance notes

- The order's file surface did not name `ui/packages/i18n` (the resolver) or `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/*` (the forward lines). Both are mechanical consequences of the read point, and the seat accepted both before this PR opened; the claim will be amended with them.
- A third `ActionParamDialog` consumer, `metadata-admin/MetadataTypeActions.tsx` (metadata-type actions in Setup), passes neither `description` nor `submitText`, so its button still says Confirm. The card names the two business-action handlers only. Noted, not filed.
- `submitText` is not interpolated: it is a button verb, and no `${…}` hole is read in it, unlike `description`.

## Verification

Readings at head `5f1a6b33` (after merging `origin/main` at `3ba52069`), unless a line says otherwise.
